subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: What exact protocol contract should connect-frame auth fields enforce before merge: byte/token-shape limits for all fields, strict shared-secret caps, or bounds only on iterated bootstrap/device paths?
rationale: The correct limit is a security-boundary and upgrade-compatibility choice because the patch changes pre-auth credential acceptance while current config allows longer shared secrets.

options.title: Repair byte and compatibility contract
options.body: Require byte-level or token-shape validation and either preserve shared-secret compatibility or document owner-approved caps with upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Accept current caps deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can accept the current 256/4096 grapheme-based caps as the protocol contract, owning the residual byte-bound and upgrade risks explicitly.

options.title: Narrow to iterated tokens
options.body: Limit only bootstrap/device fields now and defer shared-secret/password caps to a separate owner-approved compatibility discussion.

recommendation.title: Repair byte and compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Require byte-level or token-shape validation and either preserve shared-secret compatibility or document owner-approved caps with upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway protocol ownership, compatibility policy, and security-boundary acceptance for the schema package.
